headline: Cats and dogs are missing meals after a popular smart feeder went down
summary: A Petlibro outage is preventing smart pet feeders from dispensing food. Users report widespread issues with feeders, litter boxes, and water fountains. Scheduled tasks are failing, leaving pets unfed.

summary: Kinetic Publishing, from the Phasmophobia team, unveiled five ambitious new indie titles. Games are slated for release in 2027 and 2028, showcasing diverse concepts. The publisher also announced a new game from Sam Barlow.

summary: Discover all the platforms where Minions movies are available for streaming. Find a comprehensive guide to watch the entire animated franchise. Learn how to enjoy every Minions adventure from home.

summary: McDonald's is launching eight new Hello Kitty x Godzilla toys in Happy Meals this August. This highly anticipated collaboration combines two iconic franchises. Collect all eight unique toys starting next month.

headline: Made by Google 2026: Everything Announced

headline: Old School Runescape Officially Recognizes Player Who Reached Level 99 Fishing Catching Only Shrimp and Anchovies
summary: An Old School Runescape player achieved Level 99 Fishing using only shrimp and anchovies. The official OSRS X account acknowledged this unique and dedicated accomplishment. The player's unusual method highlights commitment within the game's community.

headline: Once-in-a-generation solar eclipse wows millions in UK and Europe
summary: A rare solar eclipse captivated millions across the UK and Europe. Over 95% of the Sun was covered in Cornwall, creating a dramatic sight. Parts of Spain experienced the awe-inspiring phenomenon of a total eclipse.

headline: Temperatures to soar to 38C as amber extreme heat warning comes into force
summary: An amber extreme heat warning is in effect as temperatures are forecast to hit 38C. Heat is expected to spike on Thursday, potentially breaking more records. Residents are urged to take precautions against the severe heatwave.

headline: Students wait for A-level, T-level and BTec results
summary: Students across the UK are awaiting their A-level, T-level, and BTec results. A record number are expected to secure their first-choice university places. Results day marks a crucial step for thousands planning their futures.

headline: Major Russian grain export terminals hit in Ukraine Black Sea port attack
summary: Ukrainian attacks have targeted major Russian grain export terminals. Grain exports from both Russia and Ukraine are decreasing due to ongoing conflict. Key shipping facilities and Black Sea ports are being impacted by the fighting.
